note: Vision part of the model bundle manifest (design doc 'Models, prompts, tool schema, KB pack and router thresholds ship together'). Signing, sha256 of the final .tflite files and the rest of the bundle come later.

thresholds.chosen_on: in-situ field validation photos (<= 20% good photos rejected); never the eval sets

decision: top-1 is 'unknown' or p < reject_below -> NOT RECOGNISED
reject_below <= p < confident_at_or_above -> UNCERTAIN (show top-2, ask another photo, cloud second opinion if online)

quality_gate.metric: blur effect (Crete-Roffet), grayscale, 512 px short side, box re-blur radius 4

files.note: Each file has its own temperature and reject threshold (quantization shifts probabilities). Delegate order: GPU uses fp16, CPU XNNPACK uses int8.
files.format_note: All weight buffers are inline in the flatbuffer (LiteRT 1.x cannot read external buffers).

io.input: [1,224,224,3] float32 RGB 0..255 after resize-short-side-256 + center-crop-224; normalization is inside the model

vision.temperature_note: Top-level temperature/thresholds are the PyTorch checkpoint's; use the per-file values on device.

laya.note: The app refuses a bundle whose tool_schema_version it does not support (design doc, update flow step 3).

kb.note: Built by kb/build_pack.py and kb/export_litert.py; the app opens them only after KbBundle.verify().
